notes.length: Target ~1000 words. For Chinese the unit is characters, not words; ~1000 characters is a comparable reading load.
notes.german_orthography: All German texts normalised to current spelling (Theil→Teil, giebt→gibt, daß→dass, -iren→-ieren). See modernise_de.py.
notes.chinese_script: zh-01…zh-05 are traditional, zh-06…zh-09 simplified. This boundary also tracks the classical/vernacular divide: the traditional texts are 文言文 or transitional, the simplified ones 白話文. Surface this in the UI — a student picking a traditional text is also picking a much harder one.
notes.copyright: PD = public domain. FD = in copyright, used as a short excerpt under educational fair dealing.
notes.boundaries: Every excerpt begins and ends on a sentence boundary and stands on its own as an argument.
